title: Sarnak's Mobius randomness conjecture for zero-entropy systems
exact_target: Is the Möbius function asymptotically uncorrelated with every continuous observable of every zero-entropy dynamical system?

sources.citation: Q. Liu, J. Ma, and H. Wang, The Mobius Disjointness Conjecture on infinite-dimensional torus, Introduction (2026).
Minimal zero entropy subshifts can be unrestricted along any sparse set.
